newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon downgrades LIG.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon downgrades LIG.

text.p: Analysts at Salomon Brothers said on Friday they had downgraded condom and glove maker London International Group Plc to a "hold" from a "buy".
In a note Salomon said that "while we are confident about LIG's long-term outlook, on a 1998 p/e (price/earnings ratio) of 20.1 times we believe this is fully reflected in the current share price."

Salomon said it had reined back its earnings per share forecasts for the years 1998 to 2000 as a result of increased investment plans and a slower-than-expected turnaround at Alabama-based condom and glove business Aladan.
Nevertheless it is still predicting 20 percent compound earnings per share growth between 1998 and 2001, driven by strong sales growth and margin improvements.
Salomon said in UK healthcare it believed Smith & Nephew Plc , which it upgraded last week to a buy, and Unichem Plc offered better medium-term prospects than LIG.
